directors.name: ISABELLA GRECO
directors.bio: Hi I'm Isabella, but most call me Izzy! I'm the Operations Director, I help organize our team, connect our team with sponsors, coordinate events and marketing, and help shape meaningful industry partnerships for our community of student game devs. I often also describe my role as wrangling our gaggle of creatives to realistically bring their ideas to life, while making the process fun along the way! Previously, I served as Game Design Lead for the studio, and have a background in level and environment design.

artTeam.name: MADELINE HANITIJO
artTeam.bio: Madeline "STORMY" Hanitijo is a multidisciplinary New Media artist with a crippling addiction to making interactive art, watching VTubers, and bragging about their friends.

artTeam.name: QUEEN ZERIT
artTeam.bio: hi im Queen and i am in the art department ! i like to play and draw silly things. outside of MGS, i mainly make fanart and oc drawings, and comics as well!

artTeam.name: SHAWNA SUN
artTeam.bio: Hi, my name is Shawna! I’m a New Media artist exploring personal experiences through narrative and visual storytelling. I work across various media with a focus on digital design and illustration. Remember that if Chiikawa never gave up on passing the weeding exam, you shouldn’t give up either!

gameDesignTeam.name: STANISLAW JACKOWSKI
gameDesignTeam.bio: I'm a Computer Science student who’s into video games, both playing them and now making them. Also modding them as well on the side.

gameDesignTeam.name: BRADY MATTHEW BERTRAND
gameDesignTeam.bio: Hi I'm Brady. A Performance: Acting major at TMU. Ever since I was a kid I wanted to tell stories and make video games. Look at me now! I get to do both!

programmingTeam.name: TALON JIANG
programmingTeam.bio: Ah yes, the Introvert's greatest weakness: "Tell me about yourself". You fools! I may still be an introvert, but I have levelled up enough to have gained immunity to your attack! I can now boast about my 5 years of software development experience in Java/Python and my interests in Game Dev, CGI, VR, and Engineering!

programmingTeam.name: ANGAD SIDHU
programmingTeam.bio: Hey I'm Angad, a second year computer science student who loves programming, gaming, and video editing when I have the time!

programmingTeam.name: LOGAN TOY
programmingTeam.bio: Hello, my name's Logan! I've worked on the Front-End here at MGS. I've used Java, Python, C#, and am learning more in Game Dev. Feel free to talk to me about anything music or indie-game related! And just remember, I'm not liable if I end up yapping about UNBEATABLE or KGLW, ...that's on you.

uiTeam.name: ARWEN PHAN
uiTeam.bio:
Hi there! I’m Arwen, a 2nd year New Media student and your fellow tech-art enthusiast who happened to wander into the realm of game dev (UIUX things specifically) and fell in love! My favorite games currently are the holy hoyoverse trio, valorant and silent hill f,etc.

Can’t wait to explore, co-lead and produce more awesome things for the team :) and if you also find yourself landing at the intersection between creative graphics and technical implementation, perhaps UI’s the place for you (totally not promoting)!

writingTeam.name: SOPHIE DUCHARME
writingTeam.bio: Hello! I’m in my third year of RTA Media Production, with a (now defunct) concentration in video game design. My specialties include storyboarding and concept design. I love detective games and turn-based combat!

writingTeam.name: CLARE LUE TAM
writingTeam.bio: Hi, I’m Clare! I’m a Philosophy student in my fifth year at TMU. I love reading, writing and drawing (whenever I have time). My areas of expertise include editing and narrative design! I love horror games and think that the Nintendo DS is the greatest console ever made :)

qaTeam.name: NOAH FRIEDMAN
qaTeam.bio: Noah Friedman is a multi-disciplinary creative and undergraduate Computer Science student at Toronto Metropolitan University. Noah showed an aptitude for manipulating and building software at a young age, establishing himself as the penultimate source for computer knowledge amongst his classmates and teachers alike. The eldest of four siblings to two musically proficient parents, Noah has always been surrounded by music and plays several instruments. Noah's life goal is to merge these two creative mediums into a hybrid piece of art he can call his own.

operationsTeam.name: DENZEL TUCKER
operationsTeam.bio: Marketing student interested in authentic storytelling and visual communication in and outside school. And for some reason, Osmow’s follows me... not complaining

operationsTeam.name: LEANNA GARONG
operationsTeam.bio: Hello! I'm Leanna, the Social Media Coordinator at Met Game Studios. I'm currently in the Marketing Management program at the Ted Rogers School of Management, hoping to step into the digital media industry! Gaming has been a meaningful part of my life since childhood, so getting to support Met Game Studios and connect with the community has been an amazing experience. If you’re interested in connecting with me, you can find me on LinkedIn and Instagram!

operationsTeam.name: EDWIN DENG
operationsTeam.bio: Hey all! I’m one of the many people on the marketing team at Met Games Studios and is responsible for taking club photos. Love photography and looter shooters!

operationsTeam.name: MAXIM LUKAYNOV
operationsTeam.bio: I'm a New Media student, and I love traveling and camping!
